notes: Use IDs returned by inspect_project; example IDs are placeholders.
Modifier bounds use object coordinates in millimetres. Paint bounds use world millimetres for the selected instance.
Paint states: enforce, block, clear. Replacing a selected face replaces its previous subface painting; unselected faces are preserved.
A shared resource edit affects every instance of that resource.
Rotation is relative, about the project origin, XYZ order, and places the selected instance on the bed.
Layer-height profile is a complete replacement with increasing Z values and heights inside nozzle limits.
